refuted.finding: The two header actions at the top-right draw different glyphs from the artboard: source-settings is a cog where the artboard has a rayed gear, and refresh has two arrows where the artboard has one circular arrow.
refuted.reason: The crop does show a cog and a two-arrow sync glyph where the artboard has a rayed gear and a one-arrow refresh. The artboard draws hand-made stroke SVGs, though, while the product draws the pinned codicons settings-gear and sync (docs/design/icons.json, release 0.0.46-49), which is what DS-ICON-1 requires; DS-ICON-2 measures 16x16 x4 in icon.foreground, and §6 excludes glyph-shape differences.

refuted.finding: Rows whose package has no icon show the raster default icon, an orange box image, in the 36 px icon slot. The artboard draws the placeholder as a monochrome package glyph in the icon colour on the icon tile. That puts a decorative, non-codicon colour graphic in nine of the ten visible rows.
refuted.reason: The crop shows the bundled orange default package image in the 36 px slot (hard DS-ICON-3 '36×36 ×16'). Package icons are live content under rubric §6, and the artboard's monochrome tile stands in for every row's icon. The same run's main-installed-details capture shows real .NET and parrot icons where that same artboard draws tiles. DS-ICON-1 covers codicon glyphs in icons.tsx, not package images.
